title: A selection endpoint for trim crews
heading: An Infeasible Scenario Is an Answer, Not an HTTP Error
cases: the endpoint answers 200 with the selection worth the most risk reduction within the budget
a must-trim circuit is in the selection even when other circuits are worth more per dollar
must-trim circuits that cost more than the budget give 200 with status infeasible and no circuits
a must_trim id that names no circuit in the request gets 422
a request that lists one circuit id twice gets 422, since the answer could not say which one was meant
